narr: Showers and storms developed along a frontal boundary as it moved south across the region. Locally heavy rainfall produced flash flooding in several locations.
ev: Up to four inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding across the southern portions of St. Louis County. Several roads were flooded including May Valley Lane near Fenton Creek. Several cars were stuck in the flooded intersection of Hillsboro Road and Meramec Station Road. Also, the intersection of Meramec Station Road and Smizer Mill Road was flooded.
